text:
Oh! That your flash new phone, [VAR 0100(0000)]?\c
Were you watching Lee’s exhibition match on it?
But you can’t cheer him on with your hands full!\c
You know the only way to properly cheer on Lee
would be with his famous Charizard pose![VAR 0114(0005)]
Hop! Didn’t expect to see you here today, dear.\nIsn’t this the big day?[VAR 0114(0008)]
Yeah, that’s exactly why I came running over to\nget [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0005)]
Never mind watching the match now!\c\nI’ve got it recording at home anyway.\nI record all my brother’s matches.[VAR 0114(0005)]

Come with me, [VAR 0100(0000)]!
He should be here any minute!\c
And Lee always brings presents when he visits,
so I wouldn’t forget that Bag if I were you![VAR 0114(0005)]
Now I’ve got to run! See you at mine later![VAR 0114(0005)]
What is it, love?\nIsn’t Hop expecting you?[VAR 0114(0008)]

Rushing off in that state, [VAR 0100(0000)]?
Didn’t Hop say you should bring your Bag?\c
I last saw it in your room. And don’t forget to
grab a hat for the weather![VAR 0114(0008)]
You grabbed your dad’s old Bag!
You grabbed your mum’s old Bag!

Oh, don’t you look a treat!
I knew that Bag would suit you.\c
Now hurry along. Hop is waiting, isn’t he?\c
But remember—no going into the forest for
the two of you![VAR 0114(0008)]
